epics.title: Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 Production Parity Gate for CRIE API
epics.jtbd: When the CD pipeline switches the production port 8097 from the legacy backend to Spring Boot 3, I want document upload, feedback, dialogue history, and chat persistence to work identically with SQLite and JSONL storage, so that users experience no functional loss during the migration.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero functional regression: 100% of existing endpoint behaviors preserved after migration, measured by parity test suite pass rate and zero 5xx errors in first 24h.
epics.tocConstraintRef: CD pipeline switchover gate: Spring Boot 3 must pass all parity tests before port 8097 cutover.
requirements: R1: POST /api/documents/upload and /crie/api/documents/upload accept multipart PDF/DOCX/TXT, extract text, deduplicate by content hash, persist to uploaded_documents SQLite table, and return JSON {status, doc_id, filename, summary, extracted_chars}.
R2: GET and POST /api/feedback and /crie/api/feedback read and append user feedback to data/feedback/feedback.jsonl.
R3: GET /api/dialogues/history and /crie/api/dialogues/history return the most recent dialogues from conversation_logs SQLite table.

R4: POST /api/chat and /crie/api/chat persist each dialogue (session_id, user_message, agent_answer) to conversation_logs SQLite and inject relevant text from uploaded_documents into DeepSeekService context.
R5: All four endpoint groups must be accessible without a blocking 401, matching the existing /crie/health and /crie/api/chat auth posture.
R6: All new endpoints and services must be covered by Maven tests (unit and integration).
R7: Existing SQLite database data/agent_memory.sqlite and feedback file data/feedback/feedback.jsonl must be preserved and migrated without data loss.
R8: The existing frontend src/main/resources/static/index.html must not be overwritten or modified by this migration.

slices.title: Define shared API contract for parity endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Spring Boot 3 parity gate for this epic, I want a single OpenAPI-style contract defining request/response shapes for upload, feedback, dialogue history, and chat, so that backend and existing frontend integrate without ambiguity.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the four endpoint groups, When the contract is written, Then it specifies HTTP methods, paths (both /api and /crie/api prefixes), multipart fields, JSON response schemas, and error codes.
Given the contract, When backend and frontend developers review it, Then no field name or type mismatch exists between the contract and the existing static UI expectations.
Given the contract file, When committed, Then it is the single source of truth for subsequent slices.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Contract ambiguity blocking parallel backend/frontend work.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Contract review defects: zero mismatches found in cross-review between backend and frontend.

slices.title: Implement SQLite schema and JSONL feedback storage
slices.jtbd: When implementing persistence for the parity gate, I want uploaded_documents and conversation_logs tables plus a JSONL feedback writer, so that all four endpoint groups have durable storage matching the legacy behavior.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing SQLite database, When the schema migration runs, Then uploaded_documents (id, content_hash, filename, extracted_text, summary, created_at) and conversation_logs (id, session_id, user_message, agent_answer, created_at) tables exist with indexes on content_hash and session_id.
Given a feedback POST, When the service writes, Then it appends a JSON line to data/feedback/feedback.jsonl with timestamp, user, and message fields.
Given existing data in agent_memory.sqlite, When migration completes, Then no rows are lost and foreign key integrity is maintained.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Schema migration risk of data loss during port switchover.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Migration data loss: zero rows lost, verified by row count comparison before and after.

slices.title: Implement document upload endpoint with deduplication
slices.jtbd: When implementing document upload for this epic, I want multipart PDF/DOCX/TXT handling with text extraction and SHA-256 deduplication, so that users can upload documents and avoid duplicate entries.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a multipart PDF file, When POST /api/documents/upload is called, Then the response is JSON {status, doc_id, filename, summary, extracted_chars} and the row is persisted in uploaded_documents.
Given an identical file uploaded twice, When the second upload occurs, Then the existing doc_id is returned and no duplicate row is created.
Given a DOCX or TXT file, When uploaded, Then text extraction succeeds and extracted_chars is accurate.
Given a malformed file, When uploaded, Then a 400 error with a clear message is returned and no partial row is written.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Text extraction library compatibility with Java 21.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Upload success rate: 100% for valid PDF/DOCX/TXT, zero duplicate rows for identical content.

slices.title: Implement feedback read/write endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing feedback persistence for this epic, I want GET and POST handlers that read and append to feedback.jsonl, so that user feedback is captured without loss.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a POST /api/feedback with JSON body, When called, Then a new line is appended to data/feedback/feedback.jsonl and a 201 response is returned.
Given a GET /api/feedback, When called, Then the most recent feedback entries are returned as JSON array.
Given concurrent POST requests, When they occur, Then file writes are synchronized and no lines are interleaved or lost.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Feedback write integrity: zero lost lines under 100 concurrent writes.

slices.title: Implement dialogue history and chat persistence with document context
slices.jtbd: When implementing chat and history for this epic, I want each dialogue persisted to conversation_logs and relevant uploaded document text injected into DeepSeekService context, so that conversations are grounded and retrievable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a POST /api/chat with session_id and user_message, When called, Then the dialogue is saved to conversation_logs and the agent answer is returned.
Given uploaded documents exist, When chat is processed, Then relevant extracted text is injected into the DeepSeekService prompt context.
Given a GET /api/dialogues/history, When called, Then the most recent dialogues for the session are returned from conversation_logs.
Given a chat request without session_id, When called, Then a new session_id is generated and returned.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Context injection relevance and token limits.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Chat persistence completeness: 100% of dialogues saved with session_id, user_message, agent_answer.

slices.title: Verify parity gate with Maven test pyramid
slices.jtbd: When verifying the parity gate for this epic, I want unit, integration, and E2E tests covering all four endpoint groups, so that the CD pipeline can switch port 8097 with confidence.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the new services, When unit tests run, Then text extraction, deduplication, and JSONL append logic are covered with >80% line coverage.
Given the Spring Boot application, When integration tests run with MockMvc, Then all four endpoint groups return correct status codes and JSON shapes, and no blocking 401 occurs.
Given a running instance, When E2E tests execute the critical journey (upload document -> chat with context -> retrieve history -> submit feedback), Then all steps succeed and data is persisted.
Given a backup of agent_memory.sqlite, When restore is performed, Then all rows are recovered and verified.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Test coverage gap blocking CD switchover.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Test pass rate: 100% of parity tests green before cutover; zero critical defects in first 24h.

epics.title: Parity Gate Effectiveness Telemetry (GQM)
epics.jtbd: When operating the Spring Boot 3 parity gate, I want Goal-Question-Metric telemetry measuring whether the migration preserves user-facing functionality without regression, so that the CD pipeline can be trusted and any functional loss is detected immediately.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Parity effectiveness score: percentage of user journeys (upload, feedback, history, chat) completing successfully post-migration, target 100%.
epics.tocConstraintRef: Lack of observability into post-migration functional parity.
requirements: R1: Define GQM goal: preserve 100% of user-facing functionality after Spring Boot 3 migration.
R2: Q1: Are document uploads succeeding with correct deduplication and text extraction? Metric: upload success rate and duplicate detection rate.
R3: Q2: Are feedback submissions being captured without loss? Metric: feedback write count vs. expected.
R4: Q3: Are dialogue histories and chat persistence working with document context? Metric: chat persistence completeness and context injection rate.
R5: Instrument metrics in the application and expose via a telemetry endpoint or log aggregation.

slices.title: Define GQM telemetry model and metrics
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for the parity gate, I want a written GQM decision record defining the goal, questions, and metrics, so that instrumentation is purposeful and not noise.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the parity gate goal, When the GQM record is written, Then it explicitly states the goal, three questions, and the metrics answering each question.
Given the metrics list, When reviewed, Then every metric maps to at least one question and no extraneous metrics are included.
Given the decision record, When committed, Then it is the reference for the instrumentation slice.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: GQM completeness: 100% of metrics traceable to a question.

slices.title: Instrument parity telemetry metrics
slices.jtbd: When implementing telemetry for the parity gate, I want counters and timers for upload success, feedback writes, chat persistence, and context injection, so that the GQM questions can be answered from production data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the upload endpoint, When a request completes, Then a counter increments for success/failure and a timer records duration.
Given the feedback endpoint, When a POST succeeds, Then a counter increments.
Given the chat endpoint, When a dialogue is persisted, Then a counter increments and context injection success is recorded.
Given the telemetry data, When queried via a metrics endpoint, Then the values are exposed in a machine-readable format.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Telemetry coverage: 100% of defined metrics instrumented and exposed.

slices.title: Verify telemetry accuracy with tests
slices.jtbd: When verifying telemetry for the parity gate, I want unit and integration tests that assert metric increments and exposure, so that the GQM answers are trustworthy.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a successful upload, When the test runs, Then the upload success counter increments by one.
Given a failed upload, When the test runs, Then the failure counter increments and no success counter change.
Given a chat request, When the test runs, Then the chat persistence counter increments and context injection metric is recorded.
Given the metrics endpoint, When queried in integration test, Then all defined metrics are present with correct values.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Telemetry test pass rate: 100% of metric assertions pass.
